domain: Higher Education Financial Management and Compensation Analysis
scenario:
A consortium of universities is implementing an advanced financial management and compensation analysis system to manage and analyze faculty and staff compensation across various institutions. The system aims to provide detailed insights into salary structures, bonuses, and additional compensations for different positions within the universities. The platform must support complex salary and bonus structures, track historical compensation data, and offer robust reporting capabilities to ensure transparency and equitable compensation practices.

The system will manage data for multiple universities, allowing for comparisons and benchmarking of compensation packages. It will also facilitate analysis of total pay, school-specific pay, other compensations, and bonuses paid over time. The platform should support contractual agreements, including buyouts and bonus structures, and track changes in compensation packages over the years.

The system requires a comprehensive user management module to handle access control and permissions for financial analysts, university administrators, and auditors. It should also provide tools for forecasting and budgeting to help universities manage their financial resources effectively. Additionally, the system should offer advanced analytics and visualization tools to aid in decision-making processes.
